verdict.rationale: Fin ships a documented Fin Agent API and an official TypeScript SDK (intercom-node) with concrete usage examples, plus a separate API platform for answer generation/knowledge retrieval, giving AI-native users a real programmatic path to drive Fin. However, key orchestration endpoints (Discover capabilities, Ask Fin, Run a procedure, Escalate) are only in Preview API version, and automated probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, suggesting the public API surface is not fully standardized/discoverable yet. Missing for 10: stable (non-preview) orchestration endpoints, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on developer corroboration beyond vendor docs/SDK repo.
